title: sdks: unify auth/retries & streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go + version bumps
author: Asha Patel
body: Motivation: bring SDK behavior into parity across Python/TypeScript/Go for auth token handling, retry/backoff semantics, and streaming API ergonomics. This PR consolidates the auth token refresh hooks and retry policy config into a shared interface pattern, cleans up streaming iterators to support explicit cancellation and deterministic close, and bumps package versions to publish parity releases. Summary of changes: - Introduce a unified AuthProvider interface in each SDK (python: AuthProvider, ts: AuthProvider, go: AuthProvider) and standardize token refresh hooks so background refresh vs on-demand refresh is consistent. - Unify retry defaults and backoff math: exponential backoff with jitter, max attempts configurable via client options, and consistent retryable-status mapping. - Streaming ergonomics: make stream objects implement explicit Close/aiter/cancel patterns and provide helper utilities for common streaming shapes (chat, completions). - Add compatibility shims to preserve previous ergonomics for 2 minor releases and log deprecation warnings. - Version bumps: python 1.27.0, typescript 1.32.0, go 0.9.0. Release checklist: [x] unit tests updated for all SDKs [x] integration smoke tests against hosted API [x] changelog entries for each package [x] docs snippets updated for streaming helpers [x] package build and publish pipeline validated Testing notes: ran full SDK CI matrix (py37/py39/py310, node16/node18, go1.20) and integration tests against staging inference endpoint. Observability: added debug logs for token refresh events and a metric for retry_count on client-side. Rollout: rolled out serverside compatibility for deprecation toggles; no breaking behavior expected thanks to shims. If issues arise, new client option "legacy_mode" can be enabled to restore pre-unified behavior. Related: ENG-8124, PM-2099, SUP-201

release_notes: Bump SDK versions: python v1.27.0, typescript v1.32.0, go v0.9.0. Unify auth token refresh and retry/backoff behavior across SDKs; improve streaming iterators with explicit cancel/close helpers and compatibility shims to avoid breaking changes. Added retry_count metric and debug logs for token refresh events.
notes: No server-side changes required for usual clients; deprecation shims in place.
Monitor metric client.retry_count over next 2 weeks.
